look_here_first: Start with the tiny compound leaves: a thornless densely branched shrub with odd-pinnate leaves made of several very small dull-green leaflets, sometimes on a narrowly winged rachis.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: odd-pinnate leaves with several very small leaflets

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: whitish flowers often before or with leaves

lookalikes.differences: Unlike R. aromatica, leaves are not merely three large fan-shaped leaflets; unlike thorny colima-type shrubs, R. microphylla lacks spines.
